name: One Small Fire at a Time
source:
In Overture, magic can cure all diseases, but not that of the mind. Society looks down on those whose illness is incurable by magic, and lunatics must stay in madhouses until they recover their sanity—if they ever do.

But no one has worse madness than 13-year-old Janis—not even those who long for death, or live in constant fear, or see and hear the unreal—because in a city where everyone can use magic, Janis alone can’t. “Magic Deficiency Disorder,” they call it.

Her disability makes Janis an easy target for bullying, but she still fights back despite always losing. One day, she is saved from the bullies by Aidan Woolf, a powerful mage and police commander.

In Woolf, Janis finds a father figure, but the commander didn’t come to her madhouse just for a visit. He has a mission.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230215112322/http://kidalang.com/onesmallfire/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在序曲中，魔法可以治愈一切疾病，但不能治愈心灵的疾病。社会瞧不起那些无法用魔法治愈疾病的人，而疯子必须呆在疯人院里，直到他们恢复理智——如果他们真的恢复了理智的话。

但没有人比13岁的贾尼斯更疯狂——即使是那些渴望死亡、生活在持续恐惧中、看到和听到不真实事物的人——因为在一个每个人都可以使用魔法的城市里，只有贾尼斯一个人不能。他们称之为“魔法缺乏症”。

贾尼斯的残疾使她很容易成为欺凌的目标，但尽管总是失败，她仍然奋起反抗。有一天，她被一位强大的法师兼警察指挥官艾丹·伍尔夫从恶霸手中救了出来。

在伍尔夫身上，贾尼斯找到了一个父亲的形象，但这位指挥官来到她的疯人院并不是为了拜访。他有一个使命。
